meta.description:
Duplicate the selected clip into the next free slot (Move's Copy)


Hold:
Copy + Step, copy and then paste, similar to F1 in FM-1 Firmware. 

Copy + Clip, copy then paste the clip in session view. 

Copy + Track = Copy a track and then paste the track.

meta.label: Delete / Cut
meta.description:
Hold:
Delete + Step = Cuts a step then pastes similar to the F2 functionality in original FM-1 firmware

Delete + Track = Clears/cuts the tracks pattern and then paste to another track or back to same track

Delte + Knob = Delete all locks for that parameter on the track. 



While holding a step, touch a knob, then press delete to remove the lock from that step. 



Shift + Delete: clear the whole clip (every page), then activate only page 1 which is also reset to start at steps 1 and 16

items.text:
SEQUENCE (the user's Main Layout = Sequence 1, TRACKS). Track buttons = Sequence's modes: 1 TRACKS, 2 TRIG / SOUND, 3 FX, 4 TOOLS; each brings its top row. Tap the mode you are in: the top row hides (all keys) and stays hidden until a track button is tapped again. Mute held: the tracks, to mute / solo.
→ Hold a step: "Step held". → Loop: pages. → Left / Right: page shown. → Menu: Session. → Wheel: the page belt.

STEP HELD: no select mode and no hold modes. The 8 knobs are the step's values (as TRIGGER > STEP), pads add / remove notes, Shift + knob = second value. Step + jog wheel: micro timing. Step + Volume: velocity. Hold two steps: both edited. To lock a sound or FX value, enter that page first (the belt or the TRIG / SOUND top row), then hold the step and turn its knob.

PAGES: a clip has 1-16 pages of 16 steps (256). Each page has its own start / end and can be out of the loop (the core already does this for 8 pages). Length = wheel in Loop, Shift + step 15 doubles, Right past the end adds a + page. Copy / Delete + page step: copy / clear a page.
LED: white shown, green playing, track colour in loop, dim out of loop, grey past the end.

SESSION 1, CLIPS (Menu). Columns = the 8 tracks, rows = 4 of 16 clip slots. Tap: launch. Shift + tap: launch the row (a scene). Double-tap: queue the track to stop. Plus / Minus: rows by 1; Left / Right: by 4; double-click Left: the top. Steps: under each column, stop then mute (Shift + mute: solo). Shift + Play: stop every clip.
Track buttons = Session's modes: 1 CLIPS, 2 MIDI FX, 3 FX, 4 MIX.

SHIFT (held, or tapped = sticky; the screen says SHIFT). As the user's Shift Shortcuts layout: 1 projects (4 × 8 on the pads, named and coloured), 2 global settings + exit, 3 track settings, 5 tempo, 6 metronome, 7 groove / swing, 8 pad layout, 9 keys & scales, 10 velocity on / off, 11 MIDI FX, 13 tools, 14 new clip, 15 double loop, 16 quantize. Shift + wheel: sound browser. Shift + volume: tempo.

GLOBAL SETTINGS (Shift + step 2): MIDI and SYSTEM on the knobs (popup each), then EXIT TO MOVE (wheel click). Launch quantize and the other workflow settings live in Session > SEQ. TRACK SETTINGS: Shift + step 3.

SEQUENCE 2, TRIG / SOUND: pads 1-6 are pages (repeat taps cycle: TRIG → VOICING → AMP; OSC 1-3 → MOD; …), pads 7-8 randomize (hold 1 s). Hold ENV or LFO on any page and turn a knob: that envelope or LFO modulates the parameter, the turn sets the depth.
Screens are drawn as the app draws them, in its own fonts: pictures (the room, envelope, echo, faders), the knob popup with its bar, the page name centred. Hover a layout's screen to play its frames.

Not yet drawn: the remaining sound pages' pictures (AMP, VOICE, MOD, CHIP still crop the core's), the sound browser, projects. See design/WORKFLOW.md for the clip / page data model and open questions.

EVILGENIUS ON MOVE: CLIP WORKFLOW (proposal, 16 Nov 2026)

• Every track has its own clips: 8 tracks (the track buttons pick Sequence or Session modes), 16 slots a track, launched and queued on their own, as in Move.
• A scene = slot n of all eight tracks; the 16 step buttons launch scenes in Session.
• A clip has 1-16 pages of 16 steps (256 steps).
• Menu: Note ↔ Session. Loop: pages. Shift + step: Move's shortcuts.
• Sounds stay with the track; a clip may carry its own (see WORKFLOW.md).

Groups 1-4 read left to right, top to bottom. Spec, core changes and open questions: design/WORKFLOW.md.

TODAY'S PATTERNS → CLIPS

A pattern (A01..D16) today holds all six tracks (tracks 7 and 8 start empty). Converting a project: each used pattern becomes one scene; its six track parts become six of the clips in that slot. Bank A fills scenes 1-16; banks B-D (if used) become projects of their own ("NAME B", ...).
Loop + step (pattern pick) goes: Session does it. Chains: open question.

items.text: SEQUENCE MODES (track buttons): 1 TRACKS (group 1), 2 TRIG / SOUND (group 4; randomize and mod mapping here), 3 FX (group 4 and 7; PERFORM here), 4 TOOLS (here). Tap the active mode's button: the top row hides; it stays hidden across modes until a track button is tapped. Hold a button: its top row while held. Shift + step 8 (Layout): in key, chromatic, drums, sound locks.

SESSION MODES (track buttons): 1 CLIPS (group 2), 2 MIDI FX (here), 3 FX (groups 4 and 7, on the whole mix), 4 MIX (group 4). SCENES and ARRANGE are Session pages on the wheel (here), in the first version.
